control_description: Control – Purchase order / goods receipt / invoice three-way matching (procurement). Performed weekly on all invoices received by the Finance manager. The control can be automated and covers all group entities.

IT: ERP user access review and segregation of duties.
Risk: unauthorised access, SoD conflict (e.g. creating a vendor AND paying it).
Sources: directory and IAM, HR records (leavers, transfers), ERP roles, SoD matrix.
Role of the AI: match active accounts against leavers, spot SoD conflicts and unjustified privileged accounts, then propose a remediation priority.
Conclusion: ineffective if a leaver's account remains active more than N days after departure, or if a conflict is not covered by a compensating control.
Performed monthly by the ERP administrator.
Periodic control performed by the relevant team to make sure everything is compliant.
